description.en: A modern home for writing, publishing, and the ideas worth keeping.
description.zh: 写作、发布，也留住值得记录的想法。由 WordPress 迁移而来的博客平台。

subject.en: Broad-winged faceted firefly with a small campfire
subject.zh: 展开双翼的切面萤火虫，与一小簇篝火

title.zh: 展翼，也留出呼吸的空间

description.en: The broad-winged firefly leads the mark. A small fire below its gaze supplies the second point of interest, with clear space around the complete silhouette.
description.zh: 舒展双翼的萤火虫占据主体，视线下方的小篝火形成第二处兴趣点。完整的轮廓四周留出空间，让翅尖远离圆角边缘。

title.zh: 切面的萤光，立体的火焰

description.en: Connected champagne, bronze, and gold planes describe the insect. Two visible eyes give its gaze direction; curved flame and wood grain add tactile depth to the small campfire.
description.zh: 香槟色、青铜色与金色的连续切面构成萤火虫，两只清楚的眼睛交代视线。弯曲的火焰与木纹为小篝火增添立体质感。

description.en: A deep blue-green field carries a quiet crescent, sparse stars, and cloud contours. Warm light around the flame and abdomen lifts the mark from the matte night surface.
description.zh: 深蓝绿色底面上浮现安静的月牙、疏星与云纹。火焰和尾部的暖光，让主体从哑光的夜色中轻轻浮起。

sizeNote.en: At 24–32 px, the broad wings, amber abdomen, and small fire carry the identity. At 16 px, eyes, fine legs, and wood grain simplify into the warm silhouette.
sizeNote.zh: 在 24–32 px 下，展开的翅膀、琥珀色尾部与小篝火承担辨识度。缩到 16 px 时，眼睛、细腿与木纹会合并进暖色轮廓。
